Claim 1 (Currently amended): A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein at least one of said diodes is positioned at a location that is not evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are positioned at varying radial distances around the columnar body.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, and wherein at least one face of said columnar body is not occupied by a diode.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body, and at least one face is devoid of a diode.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body, and at least one corner is devoid of a fin.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, and further includes a means for securing said base member to said columnar body.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, and further includes a means for regulating power to said light emitting diodes.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, and at least one diode being positioned at a location that is not evenly spaced radially around the body.

Claim 17 (Currently amended): A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body at varying radial distances, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins, and at least one fin is not positioned between adjacent diodes.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 wherein said body has substantially straight side walls, and at least one side wall is devoid of a diode.
